items.title: CVE-2026-126785: Incorrect Default Permissions in rmalright TR-VISION HOME
items.summary: CVE-2026-126785 is a critical vulnerability in rmalright TR-VISION HOME version 2.0.5. It involves incorrect default permissions in the IOCTL Handler component, specifically in the sub11504 function of the WFanManager.sys library. The vulnerability requires local access to exploit and can lead to significant security risks due to improper permission settings

items.summary: CVE-2026-125785 is a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Crocoblock JetEngine versions prior to 3.9.1.1. It involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability affects versions from initial releases up to 3.9.1. items.title: CVE-2026-125786: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) in ExpressTech Quiz And…
items.summary: CVE-2026-125786 is a medium severity vulnerability in ExpressTech's Quiz And Survey Master plugin (versions before 11.3.1). It involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, leading to a basic cross-site scripting (XSS) issue that allows code injection. The vulnerability has been fixed in version 11.3.1. (CVSS: 5.3)

items.title: CVE-2026-125787: Missing Authorization in ExpressTech Quiz And Survey Master
items.summary: CVE-2026-125787 is a missing authorization vulnerability in the ExpressTech Quiz And Survey Master plugin (quiz-master-next) affecting versions before 11.3.1. This flaw allows exploitation of incorrectly configured access control security levels, potentially leading to unauthorized access or actions. The issue is fixed in version 11.3.1. (CVSS: 5.4)
